verdict.rationale: The documented Document AI capabilities are exposed as API parameters: OCR, table formatting, header/footer extraction, block extraction, confidence scores, bbox and document annotations, and Document QnA. Input options (URL, Base64 or file upload) are also API-level, and official Python and TypeScript SDKs exist, so the core workflow is clearly API-accessible. However, nothing in the pack compares API coverage against the UI or states parity, and probes found no OpenAPI spec at the standard paths. missing for 10: explicit statement or evidence of UI/API feature parity, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on confirmation that UI-only features (if any) are reachable via the API.
